notes: The metro costs 3-9 CNY and is extensive, with English signage. Use Didi taxis (via Alipay). The airport express leaves from Dongzhimen. For Mutianyu and the Ming Tombs, take a tour or a Didi.
Visa: in 2026 many countries get 30 days visa-free (check for Türkiye). Alipay and WeChat Pay work with foreign cards. Set up a VPN beforehand.
Summer is 32-35°C and humid, with rain in July and August. Visit the Wall and palaces at 08:00, and use museums and malls at midday. Air pollution is low in summer.
The Forbidden City and Mao Mausoleum require your passport. Forbidden City tickets sell out online 7 days ahead. Closed on Mondays.
Peking duck costs 200-300 CNY (for 2), jiaozi 30-60 CNY, hot pot 150 CNY. Tipping is not expected. A street jianbing (savoury crepe) breakfast costs 10 CNY.
Google and WhatsApp don't work; Baidu Maps or Apple Maps do.

stops.name: Tiananmen Square
stops.tips: The world's largest public square. Expect a passport check and a security queue; visit the Mao Mausoleum in the morning.

stops.name: Forbidden City
stops.tips: The Ming-Qing palace. Book online 7 days ahead with your passport (WeChat or the official site; tickets sell out). Walking south to north takes 3.5 hours. Closed on Mondays.

stops.name: Jingshan Park
stops.tips: A hill north of the Forbidden City with 360° views over the golden roofs.

stops.name: Siji Minfu Peking Duck
stops.tips: Peking duck next to Jingshan, better and cheaper than Quanjude. Expect a queue.

stops.name: Beihai Park
stops.tips: The imperial lake and the White Dagoba; rent a rowing boat.

backups.name: Quanjude Qianmen
backups.tips: The Peking duck institution since 1864; touristy but historic.

backups.name: National Museum of China
backups.tips: A huge museum on Tiananmen Square; free entry, a good option if you have no Forbidden City ticket.

stops.name: Mutianyu Great Wall
stops.tips: In summer, set off early at 08:30 (32°C). Take the cable car and toboggan, and bring water.

stops.name: Mutianyu Village Restaurant
stops.tips: A village restaurant below the wall serving trout and dumplings.

stops.name: Hongluo Temple
stops.tips: A mountain temple in Huairou, on the way back.

backups.name: Jinshanling Great Wall
backups.tips: A wilder, emptier stretch of wall, 2.5 hours away; best for hikers.

backups.name: Subway Restaurant Mutianyu
backups.tips: Fast food at the tour entrance; an alternative to the village restaurant.

days.theme: Temple of Heaven and the hutongs

stops.name: Temple of Heaven
stops.tips: The blue-roofed Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests. In the morning, retirees fill the park with tai chi, dancing and racket games.

stops.name: Qianmen Street
stops.tips: A restored Qing-style street, with the Dashilan side alleys nearby.

stops.name: Liqun Roast Duck
stops.tips: A legendary duck restaurant in a hutong. Book ahead; it is run-down but good.

stops.name: Shichahai & Houhai Lake
stops.tips: Walk around the lake: boats in summer, ice skating in winter.

stops.name: Nanluoguxiang Hutong
stops.tips: A touristy hutong street; the side alleys hide real courtyard homes. A rickshaw tour costs 100 CNY.

backups.name: Mr. Shi's Dumplings Nanluoguxiang
backups.tips: Dumplings, as an alternative to duck.

backups.name: Drum and Bell Towers
backups.tips: A performance at the Drum Tower; an alternative to the lake.

stops.name: Summer Palace
stops.tips: Kunming Lake and the Long Corridor. It is quiet in the morning. A boat costs 20 CNY; don't miss the Marble Boat.

stops.name: Summer Palace Suzhou Street
stops.tips: A canal street inside the palace grounds; good for snacks.

stops.name: 798 Art District
stops.tips: Galleries in old factories: UCCA (60 CNY), graffiti and cafés.

stops.name: 798 Café Timezone 8
stops.tips: A café in the art district.

backups.name: Old Summer Palace Yuanmingyuan
backups.tips: The ruins of the burned palace; an alternative to 798.

backups.name: Nuage Vietnamese Houhai
backups.tips: Vietnamese food by the lake; an evening option.

stops.name: Lama Temple Yonghegong
stops.tips: A Tibetan Buddhist temple with an 18 m Maitreya carved from a single tree. Incense is included in the ticket.

stops.name: Confucius Temple Beijing
stops.tips: Quiet courtyards and stelae, plus Guozijian Street.

stops.name: Wudaoying Hutong
stops.tips: A hip hutong with cafés and vegan food, next to the Lama Temple.

stops.name: Wangfujing
stops.tips: A shopping street with Oriental Plaza and a bookshop.

stops.name: Ghost Street Gui Jie
stops.tips: A 24-hour food street lit by red lanterns; try malaxiaolongxia (spicy crayfish) and hot pot.

backups.name: Haidilao Hot Pot Wangfujing
backups.tips: A hot pot chain famous for its service.

backups.name: Ditan Park
backups.tips: The park around the Temple of Earth; an alternative to the Confucius Temple.

days.theme: Ming Tombs and the Olympic Park

stops.name: Ming Tombs Changling
stops.tips: One hour from the city; the tombs of 13 emperors and the Sacred Way statues.

stops.name: Sacred Way Ming Tombs
stops.tips: A road lined with stone animals and statues of officials.

stops.name: Changping Village Restaurant
stops.tips: Village food on the way back; try the jiaozi (dumplings).

stops.name: Olympic Park Bird's Nest
stops.tips: The 2008 Bird's Nest and Water Cube. Free from outside; 50 CNY to go inside.

stops.name: Olympic Forest Park
stops.tips: A huge park for walking, with a lake.

backups.name: Water Cube Restaurant
backups.tips: Right next to the Water Cube.

backups.name: Juyongguan Great Wall
backups.tips: A wall pass near the Ming Tombs; a second Great Wall day.

stops.name: Ritan Park
stops.tips: A park in the old embassy district; tai chi in the morning.

stops.name: Sanlitun Taikoo Li
stops.tips: Modern shopping, an Apple store and cafés.

stops.name: Jing-A Brewing Sanlitun
stops.tips: Beijing craft beer and burgers; a farewell lunch.

stops.name: Beijing Capital Airport Express Dongzhimen
stops.tips: The airport express takes 25 minutes; for Daxing, go from Caoqiao.

backups.name: Xian Lao Man Dumplings
backups.tips: A dumpling chain; a cheap farewell meal.

backups.name: Silk Street Market
backups.tips: A market for knock-offs and silk. Haggle; an alternative to Taikoo Li.
